candidates.title: Summarize long email threads for review

ease.reason: A beginner can test summaries on fictional threads, but no supplied reference supports email retrieval or stable identifiers.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: client-facing professionals may pay for thread summaries; the post establishes a workflow need, not purchase intent or payment.

evidence.reason: The retained post describes stable email references and compact conversation context, but gives no measured frequency or independent corroboration.

experimentPlan.output: A compact conversation summary with source message references and a draft reply outline.

Draft a short chronology of the conversation.
List unresolved questions and relevant facts.
Prepare a reply outline using only supplied facts.
Flag unsupported details for human review.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: Compare each factual statement in the summary and outline with the supplied fictional messages and verify its message label.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies and checks all content; a person authorizes any mailbox access and sends any reply. No real personal data is needed.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: a fictional-thread summary can be tested, but no supplied implementation reference supports mailbox access, stable IDs or summary quality.
